questions.prompt: Which great invention are they talking about?

audio.text: Judy: Do you know any ancient tools that helped travellers? Tommy: I know a special tool. It always points to the south. Judy: Perfect! It is the ancient Chinese compass.

questions.translation: 他们在谈论哪个伟大的发明？- 指南针。
questions.explanation: 根据对话中提到“always points to the south”和“ancient Chinese compass”可知答案。

questions.prompt: What invention is the girl talking about?

questions.translation: 女孩在谈论什么发明？- 造纸术。
questions.explanation: 根据对话中的“Cai Lun made papermaking much better”可知。

questions.translation: 他们在谈论哪个发明？- 古代水车。

sections.title: 三、听力理解 (第一段对话)

audio.text: Daniel: Hi, Lucy. Do you often collect old boxes and bottles at home? Lucy: Sure. They are still useful in many ways. Daniel: And our teacher told us to make new inventions with old things. Lucy: Really? I made a collecting box with old gift boxes last week. Daniel: Wow, nice work! How this small invention helps you? Lucy: It keeps my socks tidy. It's green and creative.

questions.prompt: What small invention did Lucy make?
questions.translation: 露西做了什么小发明？- 一个收集盒。
questions.explanation: 根据对话“I made a collecting box with old gift boxes last week.”得出。

questions.prompt: What can we know from the dialogue?
options: Old things can be reused to make useful inventions.
Students must make inventions every week.
Old boxes are useless in daily life.
questions.translation: 我们从对话中能了解到什么？- 旧东西可以重复使用来制作有用的发明。
questions.explanation: 根据对话主题“make new inventions with old things”得出。

sections.title: 四、听力理解 (第二段对话)

audio.text: Grace: Henry, our school will hold a small invention show next month. Are you excited? Henry: Yes! I want to make a special thing to protect our school environment. Grace: Cool! What idea do you have in mind? Henry: I plan to use bottle caps and some sticks to make a rubbish picker. Grace: That sounds great. Why do you want to make this? Henry: It's easy to make, and it can help us clean our playground easily. Grace: See, small inventions can solve big problems in our lives, right? Henry: Exactly. Waste can be useful again.

questions.prompt: What will Henry make for the invention show?
questions.translation: 亨利为发明展会做什么？- 一个垃圾捡拾器。
questions.explanation: 根据“I plan to use bottle caps and some sticks to make a rubbish picker.”得出。

questions.prompt: What is Henry's purpose(目的)of making the invention?
options: To win big prizes at the show.
To help keep the school clean.
To use up some old things at home.
questions.translation: 亨利制作这个发明的目的是什么？- 帮助保持学校清洁。
questions.explanation: 根据“it can help us clean our playground easily”得出。

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the dialogue?
options: Small creative inventions can help in our daily life.
Students can make money by selling inventions.
The school asks students to make new things.
questions.translation: 对话的主旨是什么？- 小巧有创意的发明能在日常生活中提供帮助。
questions.explanation: 根据“small inventions can solve big problems in our lives”得出。

audio.text: Long ago, people dreamed of flying in the sky like birds. Two brothers, Wilbur Wright and Orville Wright, loved studying flying. They watched birds carefully and read many books about science. They tried many times and made many flying models. In 1903, they invented the first real plane. On a cold winter day, their plane flew in the sky for the first time. Soon later, this great invention changed the whole world. Planes help people travel far away in a short time. They also carry food, clothes and other things to different places. Today, flying is a fast and safe way of travelling.

questions.prompt: Only the Wright brothers wanted to fly like birds.
questions.translation: 只有莱特兄弟想要像鸟儿一样飞翔。
questions.explanation: 原文提到“Long ago, people dreamed of flying in the sky like birds”，说明不仅是莱特兄弟有这个梦想。

questions.prompt: The brothers learnt flying only from their teachers.
questions.translation: 兄弟俩只从他们的老师那里学习飞行。
questions.explanation: 原文提到他们“watched birds carefully and read many books about science”，并非只向老师学习。

questions.prompt: The first real plane was invented in 1903.
questions.translation: 第一架真正的飞机是在1903年被发明的。
questions.explanation: 与原文“In 1903, they invented the first real plane.”一致。

questions.prompt: Planes can carry people but can't carry other things.
questions.translation: 飞机可以载人但不能载其他东西。
questions.explanation: 原文说“They also carry food, clothes and other things to different places.”。

questions.prompt: The plane is a fast and safe way to travel now.
questions.translation: 现在飞机是一种快速且安全的出行方式。
questions.explanation: 与原文“Today, flying is a fast and safe way of travelling.”一致。

sections.title: 六、听短文补全信息卡

audio.text: Hello everyone. My name is Justine, J-U-S-T-I-N-E, Justine. I'm from Class Fifteen, Grade Six. I'm happy to show you my little invention. This is my desk rubbish bag. These are my materials: cardboard, strings and tape. First, I folded the cardboard into a box. Next, I stuck strings on both sides with tape. Last, I put it up beside my desk. Now I can put my waste paper in it right away, instead of letting it fall on the floor. I hope you can have one! Thank you!

  * Next, stuck strings on both sides with tape.
  * Last, put it up beside his desks.

sections.title: 十、完形填空
sections.passage: Zhang Rongjing is [1] 12-year-old boy from Changsha. He is in Grade Six. He loves observing (观察) life and [2] to help people. One day, he saw news about children falling from tall buildings. He felt very sad and [3] to make a safe window. He learned [4] elevators (电梯) and tried many times. At last, he won a big prize in Paris. All [5] classmates are proud of him.

questions.prompt: Zhang Rongjing is [1] 12-year-old boy...
questions.translation: 张荣景是一个来自长沙的12岁男孩。
questions.explanation: 12发音以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a。

questions.prompt: ...and [2] to help people.
questions.translation: ...并且想要帮助人们。
questions.explanation: 主语He是第三人称单数，动词用wants。

questions.prompt: He felt very sad and [3] to make a safe window.
questions.translation: 他感到很难过，并决定做一个安全的窗户。
questions.explanation: 时态为一般过去时，and连接两个过去式动词felt和decided。

questions.prompt: He learned [4] elevators...
questions.translation: 他从电梯中学习并尝试了很多次。
questions.explanation: learn from... 意为“从……中学习”。

questions.prompt: All [5] classmates are proud of him.
questions.translation: 他的所有同班同学都为他感到骄傲。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词classmates应用形容词性物主代词his。

sections.title: 十一、连环画填空
sections.passage:
1. Zhang Heng is a famous inventor from ancient China. He was curious(好奇的) about earthquakes(地震). He wanted to help people.
2. He spent many years thinking and testing. He wanted to [1] a machine to tell where earthquakes happened.
3. At last, he made the seismograph(地动仪). It has a big [2] jar with eight dragons around it. It could tell the direction of earthquakes.
4. When an earthquake happened, it would drop a ball from the [3] of the jar into a frog's mouth. So people could know the direction.
5. Before this, people could not know about earthquakes [4]. The invention helped the court take measures quickly.
6. Today, scientists use the [5] idea as his invention. They can get the information about earthquake quickly with modern tools.

questions.prompt: He wanted to [1] a machine...
questions.translation: 他想制造一台机器来判断地震发生的地方。
questions.explanation: want to do sth. 后面接动词原形make。

questions.prompt: It has a big [2] jar...
questions.translation: 它有一个周围环绕着八条龙的大圆罐。
questions.explanation: 形容罐子的形状，用round。

questions.prompt: ...from the [3] of the jar into a frog's mouth.
questions.translation: ...从罐子中间掉落一颗球到一个青蛙的嘴里。
questions.explanation: 结合上下文和词库，from the middle of...

questions.prompt: ...people could not know about earthquakes [4].
questions.translation: ...人们无法轻易地了解地震情况。
questions.explanation: 副词easily修饰动词know。

questions.prompt: Today, scientists use the [5] idea as his invention.
questions.translation: 今天，科学家们使用了和他发明相同的想法。
questions.explanation: the same idea 意为“相同的想法”。

sections.title: 十二、阅读海报判断正误
sections.passage: Inventor: Yuan Longping, Tu Youyou, Hou Debang, Wang Xuan. (Four information cards about hybrid rice, artemisinin, Hou's Process for Soda Ash, and Chinese Laser Typesetting System)

questions.prompt: Yuan Longping made hybrid rice in 1972 for malaria.
questions.translation: 袁隆平在1972年为了治疗疟疾而制造了杂交水稻。
questions.explanation: 杂交水稻是1973年发明的，且用于解决饥饿问题，而青蒿素才是用于治疗疟疾的。

questions.prompt: Artemisinin saves sick people's lives in poor countries.
questions.translation: 青蒿素拯救了贫困国家生病人们的生命。
questions.explanation: 与原文“It saves millions of sick people's lives in poor countries.”一致。

questions.prompt: Hou Debang's work brought people with nice books.
questions.translation: 侯德榜的工作给人们带来了好书。
questions.explanation: 侯德榜的制碱法用于纯碱生产，带来好书的是王选的激光照排系统。

questions.prompt: Wang Xuan finished his printing tool in 1943.
questions.translation: 王选在1943年完成了他的印刷工具。
questions.explanation: 王选的汉字激光照排系统是在1979年发明的，1943年是侯德榜的制碱法。

questions.prompt: Three of these inventions appeared after the year 1970.
questions.translation: 这些发明中有三个出现在1970年之后。

sections.title: 十三、阅读理解 A
sections.passage: Table of inventions: Post-it Notes (1968-1974, Silver & Fry), Ball Pen (1938, Biro), Band-Aid (1920, Dickson), Popsicle (1905, Frank), Chips (1853, Crum).

questions.prompt: What is the same about all these five inventions?
questions.translation: 这五项发明有什么共同点？- 它们都源于意外或生活中的问题。
questions.explanation: 综合表格中的小故事，每项发明都伴随着偶然或生活中的小困扰。

questions.prompt: Why did the weak glue become useful at last?
questions.translation: 为什么这种粘性弱的胶水最终变得有用了？- 一位发明家发现了它特殊的用途。
questions.explanation: 根据Post-it Notes的故事，Fry用它来做粘性书签。

questions.prompt: Which invention was made for people's small cuts?
questions.translation: 哪项发明是为了人们的小切口/伤口而制作的？- 创可贴。
questions.explanation: 根据Band-Aid故事中妻子切菜割破手指得出。

questions.prompt: We can infer that great inventors are usually [blank].
questions.translation: 我们可以推断伟大的发明家通常是怎样的？- 心思缜密、善于思考的。
questions.explanation: 面对生活中的意外，他们能深入思考并加以改进。

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.translation: 整篇文章的主旨是什么？- 意外和细致的思考可以创造伟大的发明。
questions.explanation: 文章讲述了多项因意外和思考而诞生的发明。

sections.title: 十四、阅读理解 B
sections.passage: Ma Jun was a great inventor in ancient China. One day, he saw farmers carrying water to fields with heavy buckets. They were so tired... First, Ma Jun started to watch carefully... Then, he studied hard to learn more... After that, Ma Jun began to test again and again... At last, he made the wonderful waterwheel.

questions.prompt: Why did Ma Jun want to invent a new tool?
questions.translation: 马钧为什么想发明新工具？- 他想帮助疲惫的农民。
questions.explanation: 根据“He wanted to make a tool to help farmers.”得知。

questions.prompt: What is the correct order of Ma Jun's invention process?
questions.translation: 马钧发明过程的正确顺序是什么？- 产生想法 -> 仔细观察 -> 努力学习 -> 做测试
questions.explanation: 文中先提到看到农民挑水产生想法，然后仔细观察，接着查阅资料学习，最后不断测试。

questions.prompt: What can we infer about Ma Jun from the passage?
questions.translation: 我们能从文章中推断出马钧是一个什么样的人？- 他体贴且有毅力。
questions.explanation: 根据他不断尝试、永不放弃以及为农民着想的精神得出。

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.translation: 整篇文章的主旨是什么？- 马钧如何以良好的精神发明了水车。
questions.explanation: 文章完整叙述了马钧发明水车的全过程及他的精神。

questions.prompt: What does the writer want to tell us?
questions.translation: 作者想告诉我们什么？- 伟大的发明来自于好的想法和努力的工作。
questions.explanation: 通过马钧的故事传达发明需要观察、学习和坚持不懈的努力。
